_readme: Source of truth for docs/stellar/pilot-budget-and-grant.md. Every value marked TODO is a placeholder: replace it with the real value, then update the matching table in the .md file. Money values are numbers in `currency`. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD; placeholders use TODO-YYYY-MM-DD. Run `npm test` to check that totals and shares still add up.

milestones.name: Grant-aligned repository, demo, and documentation
milestones.deliverable: Public repository with seeded demo, dashboard, VS Code plugin, and Stellar Payments documentation in docs/stellar/

milestones.name: Stellar Payments sandbox and payment-adapter specification
milestones.deliverable: Testnet merchant credentials configured, payment-request and Horizon-matching specification signed off

milestones.name: Secure invoice reconciliation and webhooks
milestones.deliverable: Daily reconciliation, signed outgoing webhooks with per-customer secrets, refund procedure implemented in sandbox
milestones.statusNote: Sandbox reconciliation, webhooks and refunds are built on the StellarPayPhase2 branch and waiting for review.

milestones.name: Pilot payment and aging dashboards
milestones.deliverable: Dashboards for payment status, collection rate, aging, refunds, and settlement reports

milestones.name: Pilot with one school or training provider
milestones.deliverable: One institution onboarded, real (or pilot-limited) payments processed and reconciled, staff feedback collected

milestones.name: Security, accessibility, and deployment hardening
milestones.deliverable: Security and privacy review, accessibility audit, production deployment with backups and monitoring
